My name is from Dowa, and this small plot of beans is important for my family's food and some little money at the market. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I don't waste my scarce fertilizer here — if I get any FISP coupon, I use it on my maize plot, not the legumes. I will put some manure from my goats and chickens to help the soil, and use seed I saved from last year because improved bean seed is expensive and not always available. I will do the work with my wife and children; maybe one or two days of hired labor for weeding if the rains are heavy.
